about:
Eco Solar Hawaii was founded in 2008 by Ben Parish in Waipahu, Hawaii, and has served residential customers on O'ahu for over 15 years. The company operates as a privately held, founder-led business focused on home energy systems.

The firm designs and installs solar photovoltaic arrays, Tesla Powerwall battery storage, and electric-vehicle charging equipment, integrating all components through the Tesla app for unified monitoring. As a Tesla Powerwall Premier Certified Installer and Maxeon Preferred Partner, Eco Solar has completed more than 3,600 residential installations, handling custom system design, permitting, and on-site installation with its own crews.

The customer base consists almost entirely of single-family homeowners on O'ahu seeking to reduce utility bills and gain backup power. The company does not install on corrugated aluminum, tile, wood-shake roofs, or multi-family buildings of three or more units.

Parish attributes the company's growth to three core principles—quality, service, and a commitment to certified installations—which have earned Eco Solar a BBB A+ rating since 2011 and recognition as Hawaii's Best solar installer.
